subject.title: [Feature]:  Expose claude-cli thinking blocks as reasoning on /v1/responses (and /v1/chat/completions)`

question: Should Gateway HTTP reasoning reuse the existing agent-level off/on/stream policy, and should Claude CLI’s token-only wire be exposed as progress rather than reasoning text?
rationale: This changes a public OpenAI-compatible API and its reasoning-disclosure boundary; source evidence supports multiple implementation shapes but cannot establish the intended privacy or compatibility policy.

options.title: Reuse the existing reasoning policy
options.body: Gate HTTP output through the existing off/on/stream setting, emit readable embedded reasoning when present, and expose Claude CLI token estimates only as progress.

options.title: Add request-level HTTP opt-in
options.body: Support a documented per-request opt-in alongside agent policy, with explicit precedence and compatibility rules.

options.title: Keep reasoning off HTTP
options.body: Retain reasoning visibility only on existing channel and control surfaces and document the HTTP omission as intentional.

recommendation.title: Reuse the existing reasoning policy
recommendation.body: Gate HTTP output through the existing off/on/stream setting, emit readable embedded reasoning when present, and expose Claude CLI token estimates only as progress.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work defines the current Claude CLI reasoning event shape and its connection to the shared privacy gate.
